title: Uncovering Why LLMs Fail: From Internal Mechanisms to Adversarial Reasoning Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.37369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are usually evaluated by final-output correctness or safety, yet an endpoint label does not reveal how a failure develops throughout the reasoning process. We therefore ask whether ordinary reasoning failures and adversarially induced failures can be characterized using the same internal coordinates. Towards this end, we in this paper study a white-box diagnostic framework CauTrace to disclose the root-cause of why LLM fails from three fundamental inspections: Functional States, Propagation of Representation, Temporal-State Coordination and Reasoning Trajectory. translated_title: 揭示大语言模型为何失败：从内部机制到对抗性推理轨迹
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）通常通过最终输出的正确性或安全性来进行评估，然而终点的标签无法揭示失败是如何在整个推理过程中逐步形成的。因此，我们提出这样一个问题：普通的推理失败与对抗性诱导的失败是否能够用相同的内部坐标来刻画。为此，本文研究了一个白盒诊断框架CauTrace，从三项基本检查入手揭示LLM失败的根本原因：功能状态、表征传播、时间-状态协调与推理轨迹。首先，创新性地定义了七种功能状态，用以表示LLM中的支持与约束处理过程。其次，表征变化的传播度量了七种状态之间的变化如何在后续的Transformer块中持续存在。第三，时间-状态协调与轨迹拓扑刻画了承诺形成的时机与推理路径的形态……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出白盒诊断框架CauTrace，通过七种功能状态、表征传播、时间-状态协调与推理轨迹等内部机制分析，统一刻画大语言模型普通推理失败与对抗性诱导失败的根本原因。
en_tdlr: Proposes CauTrace, a white-box diagnostic framework that uncovers the root causes of LLM failures—including ordinary reasoning errors and adversarially induced ones—by analyzing internal mechanisms such as seven functional states, representation propagation, temporal-state coordination, and reasoning trajectories.
